name: Gondelsheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gondelsheim (a yellow sheaf on red).
history: Municipal flag of Gondelsheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gondelsheim arms — yellow sheaf on red
